clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshire, a Bottle of Zombie Juice is bound for Abercrombie, a reclusive hermit in Duskwood. The potent liquor is brewed from rot blossom, and Abercrombie says he needs it to keep warm.

Rot blossoms gathered in Duskwood go into this harsh brew. The bartender in Darkshire warns that it is potent enough to raise the dead. Most folk want nothing to do with such a vile drink, but Abercrombie, an eccentric hermit, says it is the only thing that keeps him warm on the damp, cold nights by his lonely shack.
